# Landbot

Landbot is a no-code chatbot builder that enables businesses to create conversational experiences for customer engagement, lead generation, and support across various messaging channels.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/landbot/.

## Actions

- **Delete Bot**: Delete a specific bot from your account.
- **Get Customer By Phone**: Retrieve customer details by phone number.
- **List Agents**: Retrieve a list of agents in your landbot account.
- **List Bots**: List all bots in your landbot account.
- **List Channels**: List all channels integrated with your account.
- **List Customers**: List customers who have interacted with your bot.
- **List WhatsApp Templates**: List all whatsapp message templates available for the account.
